'''Gerard Escoda Alegret'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Escoda|Alegret}} (born 8 September 1970) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed at the [[1988 Winter Olympics|1988]], [[1992 Winter Olympics|1992]], [[1994 Winter Olympics|1994]] and the [[1998 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/es/gerard-escoda-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418094508/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/es/gerard-escoda-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Gerard Escoda |accessdate=23 March 2018 |quote=Full name: Gerard Escoda Alegret}}</ref>
